sources.name: NWS Point Forecast Matrices (IEM AFOS archive)
sources.operator: Iowa Environmental Mesonet, archiving National Weather Service text products
sources.authorization: Anonymous public archive of NWS products; no key or account.
sources.license: NWS products are US government works; IEM asks for reasonable request rates.
sources.clock_basis: WMO header day/hour/minute cross-checked against the product's own issuance line; the product text is unchanged from dissemination.
sources.timezone: Issuance line in WFO local standard/daylight time; columns in local hours with a UTC row.
sources.corrections: Each reissued product is a separate vintage with its own issuance clock.
sources.point_in_time: Eligible: the archived text is the product as issued, with its issuance clock.
sources.unverified_entities_note: Point mappings for other stations have not been verified against a retained product.

sources.name: NWS Daily Climate Reports (IEM AFOS archive)
sources.operator: Iowa Environmental Mesonet, archiving National Weather Service text products
sources.authorization: Anonymous public archive of NWS products; no key or account.
sources.license: NWS products are US government works; IEM asks for reasonable request rates.
sources.clock_basis: WMO header of the final report, issued after the observation day ends; same-day reports are rejected as preliminary.
sources.timezone: Climate day in local standard time.
sources.corrections: Corrected reports are separate products with later issuance clocks.
sources.authority_note: KXHIGH contract text names The Weather Company, so CLI is a reference observation, never the settlement label.
sources.point_in_time: Eligible as a reference observation available at its issuance clock.

sources.name: The Weather Company climate portal for Kalshi
sources.authorization: Public portal named in the contract rules; anonymous GET by date, the same endpoint as the existing label service.
sources.license: Public portal referenced by Kalshi contract rules; bounded research use.
sources.clock_basis: Provider issue clocks are often empty, so availability begins at this collection's receipt.
sources.timezone: Report date is the station's local calendar date.
sources.corrections: Status official or revised only; preliminary reports are refused.
sources.authority_note: Retained KXHIGH contract text names The Weather Company as the settlement source.
sources.point_in_time: Labels are outcomes and are never used as decision-time features.

sources.timezone: Close and expiration times in UTC.
